info.title: CAP-001 Retail Banking API — CHAPS Payment Extensions (JRN-028)
info.description: Extensions to the CAP-001 (Retail Banking) API surface for CHAPS high-value payment initiation and authorisation. This contract documents the CHAPS-specific endpoints added by JRN-028. These endpoints are served by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) internally — channels call the CAP-001 API surface; internal routing to SVC-001 is an L3 concern.

post.description: Creates a CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053) for PER-001. Publishes CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated (EVT-108) which triggers CoP check and sanctions screening. Returns the intent ID and initial status. Phase: PH-077.

beneficiary_sort_code.description: 6-digit UK sort code in XX-XX-XX format

beneficiary_name.description: Beneficiary account name for CoP check

beneficiary_lei.description: ISO 17442 LEI — mandatory for corporate beneficiaries from 1 May 2025 (GOV-003-R03)

purpose_code.description: ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code — use PROP for property purchase

mortgage_account_id.description: FK to ENT-016 — required when is_mortgage_completion_payment = true

example.beneficiary_name: Smith & Jones Solicitors LLP Client Account

201.description: CHAPSPaymentIntent created. CoP check and sanctions screening initiated asynchronously.

chaps_cutoff_time.description: CHAPS customer cut-off time for today in ISO 8601 (e.g. 16:00:00). Display if current time is within 30 min.

400.description: Validation error — invalid beneficiary details, missing mandatory fields, or EISCD modulus check failure

409.description: Account status not active, or duplicate payment intent detected

422.description: Amount below minimum, account not eligible for CHAPS

get.description: Returns current status of CHAPSPaymentIntent including CoP result, sanctions status, and authorisation state. Projection varies by phase: CoP result surfaced only after PH-078; sanctions result never surfaced in full.

cop_matched_name.description: Partial match: name as held at receiving bank (if returned by CoP scheme)

uetr.description: RTGS Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference — visible to customer for tracing

x-projection-note.description: sanctions_screening_result NEVER included in response. If blocked: status = failed, no sanctions detail.

403.description: Forbidden — chaps_intent_id belongs to different customer_id

post.summary: Customer confirms intent to proceed after CoP no/partial match
post.description: PER-001 confirms they wish to proceed after reviewing a no_match or partial_match CoP result. Records customer_cop_confirmation = confirmed_proceed on ENT-053. Mandatory before proceeding to PH-080 when cop_result IN (no_match, partial_match). Phase: PH-078 ALT-001, ALT-002.

confirmation.description: Customer's explicit choice after CoP mismatch warning

200.description: Confirmation recorded. If confirmed_proceed: status advances to sanctions_pending.

409.description: Intent status does not require CoP confirmation (cop_result is match or intent not in cop_complete state)

post.description: PER-001 provides SCA credential to authorise the CHAPS payment. SVC-001 validates SCA with SVC-100 (dynamic linking — amount + beneficiary). On success: publishes CHAPSPaymentAuthorised (EVT-110), reserves funds from Account.available_balance, and transitions ENT-053 status to authorised. Phase: PH-080.

sca_credential.description: SCA credential token from SVC-100 challenge — biometric or OTP

irrevocability_confirmed.description: Customer confirmed irrevocability warning. Required for audit evidence.

estimated_settlement.description: Estimated settlement time (CHAPS typically settles within minutes)

409.description: Insufficient funds, CHAPS cut-off passed, or intent not in sanctions_complete state

422.description: SCA dynamic linking validation failed — amount or beneficiary mismatch

BearerAuth.description: JWT issued by SVC-100 (IAM). Claims include customer_id, entitlements, and SCA_COMPLETED flag.
